name: one-india-platform
description: Read approved 1 India Family Mart retail reports: sales and targets, monthly target pace, store closures, footfall, stock and stock ageing with cost values, Inventory Intelligence, dispatch progress, sell-through, category and season sales, the buying plan and store health reviews, catalogue photos, monthly sales vs last year, store P&L, loyalty summary, shop cash and day-end checks, booked rent and salary (named salary approval required).

interface.longDescription: Ask plain questions about your approved 1 India stores and get answers from the platform's own reports: sales, targets and the daily pace needed to hit this month's target, which stores were closed, footfall, stock and how old it is, sell-through, category and season sales, warehouse dispatch progress, the buying plan review and a full Store Health Review. Separately approved reports add stock cost values, Inventory Intelligence, monthly sales against last year, Finance store P&L with margins, the company loyalty summary, shop cash book and day-end checks, Finance booked rent and monthly salary. Salary needs the platform's named salary-access approval, rechecked on every call; bank, tax and contact details are never returned. You sign in with your own account and choose your stores and reports; business records stay read-only. If a report cannot answer a question, the assistant can save a short summary for the owner after you confirm the exact text.
capabilities: Read approved retail sales, targets, closures and stock reports
Read stock cost values, ageing and dispatch order values
Read monthly sales vs last year, store P&L and loyalty summary
Read shop cash, booked rent and salary (named approval)
defaultPrompt: Check my 1 India access and show the reports and stores I can use.
How did Banda do last week against target, with category sell-through?
What is this month's target for my stores and the daily pace we need?
